queries.query: Balıkesir Turkey official cadastral parcel map geoportal cadastral service
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official national TKGM Parsel Sorgu service, the TKGM Balıkesir Kadastro Müdürlüğü page, and the official HGM GeoPortal. The official parcel viewer shell was reachable, but no anonymous parcel feature response was verified.

queries.query: Balıkesir resmi parsel sorgu kadastro harita belediyesi
queries.result: Türkçe first-party discovery identified TKGM Parsel Sorgu as the official public parcel-location service and the Balıkesir Kadastro Müdürlüğü as the local cadastral office. Official map/search routes were inspected without login; no safe anonymous parcel ID plus polygon response was obtained.

registryCustodian: Tapu ve Kadastro Genel Müdürlüğü (TKGM), Balıkesir Kadastro Müdürlüğü; the official TKGM parcel viewer is the public national service.

registryEvidence.evidence: TKGM's official organizational page lists Balıkesir Kadastro Müdürlüğü under the Bursa Regional Directorate, and TKGM's official service page identifies Parsel Sorgu as the parcel-location service.
